blocks_element.text: The Mongolian Cashmere Crewneck Sweater feels buttery soft, and it is comfortable to wear. It is cozy and warm, with a light, just-right weight that layers well under blazers and jackets. This classic wardrobe staple pairs with jeans, skirts and dress pants. The red and burgundy shades look rich and beautiful. It is bought for oneself and as a gift for family, friends and children, who love it. Customers say it fits true to size.
